description: Full Crem/Program input workflows and composed state owners, including capacity correction, versus PR2927.

provenance.benchmarkBuild: cabal build all --builddir=dist-newstyle-lint, GHC 9.6.7 -O1, strict warnings

limits: Two balanced pairs per workload on CPU0, three nodes, RTS -N1 -T. Burst-repeat is a second set of two pairs of the identical burst workload, added to investigate variability.

Small and large are closed loop with one outstanding transaction per client. Burst and burst-repeat submit without waiting for confirmation. Finite local workloads, not maximum deployment throughput or confirmation after a durable disk flush.
Identical datasets checked by hash. Real Cardano transactions, network, API and asynchronous persistence.
No concurrent builds or tests during measured runs.
Observed pair changes are not confidence bounds.

summaries.summaryDescription: Each client splits its funds into 1000 outputs (1-in 10-out), then holds that plateau with full-value self-transfers so every snapshot carries the large UTxO set.
